name: markall
comment: Named markall (not in the remaster, gcc inlined it there): Lua 3.1 source name (lgc.c static markall: the stacks with markobject, globalmark, travlock, luaT_travtagmethods(markobject), in that order; called by lua_collectgarbage); was luaC_markall.

name: globalmark
comment: Named globalmark (not in the remaster, gcc inlined it there): Lua 3.1 source name (lgc.c static globalmark: for every global of rootglobal that is not nil, markobject of its value and strmark of its name); was luaC_travglobal.

name: travlock
comment: Named travlock (not in the remaster, gcc inlined it there): Lua 3.1 source name (lgc.c static travlock: markobject of every locked entry of LState refArray / refSize); was luaC_travstack.

name: strmark
comment: Named strmark (not in the remaster, gcc inlined it there): Lua 3.1 source name (lgc.c static strmark: marks a string, marked = 1); was luaC_strmark.
